# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::scrollbar`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

The overlay scrollbar of a scroll area (`widget.scrollbar`): a 9 px transparent track with a
6 px rounded thumb in the `accent` colour, shown while the pointer is over the area or the thumb
is held, taking no layout space. [`thumb_geometry`](scrollbar.md#fn.thumb_geometry) is the pure part; `Ui::scrollbar` (used by
[`Ui::scroll_area`](../ui.md#method.Ui.scroll_area), not called by apps) registers and draws it.

The bar has no node of its own and is no tab stop: the owning area's node carries the offset
and the actions.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/scrollbar.rs:1`

**Fields**

- <a id="structfield.ThumbGeometry.track"></a>`pub track: Rect`

  The 9 px bar, along the viewport's right (vertical) or bottom (horizontal) edge.

- <a id="structfield.ThumbGeometry.thumb"></a>`pub thumb: Rect`

  The 6 px thumb inside it, 1 px from the viewport's edge.

- <a id="structfield.ThumbGeometry.travel"></a>`pub travel: f64`

  How far the thumb can travel along the axis: the track's length minus the thumb's.

- <a id="structfield.ThumbGeometry.range"></a>`pub range: f64`

  The offset range the travel maps to: `extent - viewport`.

## Functions

<a id="fn.thumb_geometry"></a>
### Function `thumb_geometry`

```rust
pub fn thumb_geometry(
    axis: Axis,
    viewport: Rect,
    offset: f64,
    extent: f64,
    corner: bool,
) -> Option<ThumbGeometry>
```

The bar of `axis` for a `viewport` showing `extent` px of content at `offset`, or `None` when
the content fits (or the numbers are not usable). The thumb's length is
`viewport / extent * track`, at least [`MIN_LENGTH`](scrollbar.md#constant.MIN_LENGTH); its place is `offset / (extent -
viewport)` of the travel. `corner` says the other bar is shown too: this track then stops
short of it by [`BAR`](scrollbar.md#constant.BAR).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/scrollbar.rs:64`
